title: Commission report finds devastating shifts in the Arctic and record-breaking marine heatwaves
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 30 Sep 2026 The ocean is changing at an alarming pace with direct consequences for marine life, coastlines and communities all across the world. That is the main conclusion of the tenth report on the state of the ocean, published today by the Marine Environment Monitoring Service of Copernicus, the EU Earth observation programme.
